'''Normajean''' (Japanese: '''ノブコ''' ''Nobuko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP190|The Brockster Is In!]]''. She is the final character of the day to appear in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''.

Normajean works at a [[Pokémon Day Care]] as an apprentice and was in charge of caring for several [[baby Pokémon]] while traveling on a ship that was headed towards [[Twinleaf Town]]. The Pokémon she was caring for were {{p|Pichu}}, {{p|Cleffa}}, {{p|Igglybuff}}, {{p|Teddiursa}}, {{p|Azurill}}, {{p|Smoochum}}, and {{p|Wynaut}}.

The Pokémon Normajean was caring for wandered off while travelling on the ship, towards {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, while Normajean was worriedly looking for them. She introduced herself to the group. She was ecstatic when she found out that {{an|Brock}} was a {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}}, because she works at a Day Care.

Later on, a group of {{p|Tentacruel}} found their way onto the ship, due to {{TRT}} stealing their treasured bottle cap. The Tentacruel attacked anyone near them; several Pokémon, including Normajean's Pokémon, became {{status|poison}}ed by the Tentacruel. Brock took care of them, since there was no [[Nurse Joy]] on board. Brock, with the help of his friends, tried different methods to try to heal the sick Pokémon but was unsuccessful. Suddenly, Brock's {{TP|Brock|Happiny}} evolved into a {{p|Chansey}} and used {{m|Softboiled}} to heal Normajean's Pokémon. After this, Normajean expressed her gratitude to Brock for saving the Pokémon.

** They are also the final [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] of their respective series, ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'' and ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''.
